description_en: Obtain the aggregated agent status metrics for skill groups under hotline monitoring. Supports grouped queries by instance, time range, department, and skill group
description_zh: 获取热线监控下技能组坐席汇总状态量。支持实例、时间区间、部门、技能组分组查询
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs get-skill-group-and-agent-status-summary --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --start-date 1615083365000 --end-date 1617761765000 --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --dep-ids 100 --group-ids 123 --exist-department-grouping false --exist-skill-group-grouping false --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSkillGroupAndAgentStatusSummary

parameters.help_en:
AICCS instance ID.  
You can obtain it in the **Instance Management** section of the left-side navigation pane in the [Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh:
AICCS实例ID。
您可以在[智能联络中心控制台](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的**实例管理**中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Start date UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始日期时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: End Datetime Variable as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束日期时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: Page size. The value must be greater than **0**. Default value: **20**
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小。取值大于**0**，默认值：**20**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Current page. The value must be greater than **0**. Default value: **1**
parameters.help_zh: 当前页。取值大于**0**，默认值：**1**
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query by department grouping. Default value: **false**. Valid values:  

- **true**: Yes.  
- **false**: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否根据部门分组查询。默认值：**false**。取值：

- **true**：是。
- **false**：否
parameters.name: exist_department_grouping

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query by skill group grouping. Default value: **false**. Valid values:
- **true**: Yes.
- **false**: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否根据技能组分组查询。默认值：**false**。取值：
- **true**：是。
- **false**：否
parameters.name: exist_skill_group_grouping
